Method of Attack: Remote access trojan with capabilities including collecting system information, listing folders and running processes, executing commands and files from C2 server, downloading, uploading, deleting files, taking screenshots, executing .NET code and PowerShell commands via DLLs WoodySharpExecutor and WoodyPowerSession, process hollowing into Notepad, self-deletion from disk, encrypted C2 communication using RSA-4096 and AES-CBC
Impacted Systems: Russian aerospace and defense entity OAK
Attack Vector: Phishing emails delivering payload via ZIP archive files or Microsoft Office documents exploiting Follina vulnerability
